What we do & about us

We don't sell kitchens — we build them for you

DUBRÁ Studio is a Prague-based atelier for bespoke kitchens and furniture. Each project begins with listening — to the space, the light, the way you live. The result is never off a shelf. It is designed from scratch, made by hand, and built to last.

Our process

How we work with you

From the first conversation to the final installation — a clear, honest process with no surprises along the way.

01

Free consultation

We come to your space, listen to what you need, and ask the right questions. No pressure, no obligation.

02

Design & proposal

A 3D visualisation and a clear, itemised quote. You know exactly what you're getting and what it costs.

03

Production

Your furniture is made by hand in our Prague workshop. Solid materials, precise joinery, no shortcuts.

04

Installation

The same team that built your furniture installs it cleanly and on time. We leave no mess behind.

Our story

A studio built on craft, not catalogue

DUBRÁ Studio was founded with a single conviction: that the most important room in a home deserves more than a standard solution. Every project we take on is a collaboration — beginning with the architecture of the space and ending with the finest material detail.

Our team of six craftsmen works exclusively from our Prague atelier. We use solid oak, walnut, and ash alongside selected European laminates and natural stone. We do not rush. We do not compromise. We build for the long term.
